z.$description:
Layering: a system-wide invariant (what covers what), not geometry. The
family declares the order; the values only have to preserve it. Before this
it was five magic numbers in five files: Menu and Tooltip both sat at 900,
so a tooltip on a menu item resolved by DOM order rather than by design;
Dialog and ConfirmDialog both sat at 1000, and ConfirmDialog opens from a
Dialog, so it worked only by accident of mount order; Toast, the one thing
that must float above everything, declared nothing at all. The order, least
to most interruptible: nav < sheet < dropdown < tooltip < modal <
modal-nested < palette < onboarding < toast.

nav.$description: Fixed page navigation: a bottom bar, a sticky top bar. Arena draws none of these; the slot exists because the invariant is system-wide and a consumer's own shell is part of the system. Below dropdown, so a Menu opened from the bar covers it rather than resolving by DOM order, which is the failure this family was created to end. A shell drawn against this slot also reads --pad-safe-bottom, in contracts/design/environment.css, and --layout-bar for its own height

sheet.$description: A non-modal panel anchored to an edge: a cart, a filter drawer, a detail pane that leaves the page usable behind it. Arena draws none of these either, and the slot exists for the same reason nav does. Above nav, because a sheet that slides over a fixed bar and lands under it is the failure; below dropdown, because a Menu opened from inside the sheet belongs over it. It is NOT modal: a panel that takes the whole interaction is a Dialog, which is two slots higher and has a scrim to say so

dropdown.$description: Menu's panel: a dropdown anchored to its trigger

tooltip.$description: above dropdown, so a tooltip on a menu item wins

modal-nested.$description: ConfirmDialog, which opens from a Dialog

onboarding.$description: the coachmark; the scrim beneath it derives at the point of use as calc(var(--z-onboarding) - 10): one slot, two uses

toast.$description: floats above everything, including onboarding: a transient notice raised by an action taken inside a dialog must stay visible
